text: Prospective rank-method plan added at local 79dacf69: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-rank-method-plan-v2.md, supported by docs/verification/umvpa-rank-math-review-20261007/README.md. It is not a frozen v2 protocol and changes no v1 criterion, population, stream or result. Proposed sequence: repair score geometry, establish a conservative Gaussian reference, perform a bounded paired method/sizing pilot, pursue efficiency only if necessary, then freeze the actual v2 qualification. The proposal separates formal error control plus an upper-size check from near-nominality diagnostics and selects a feasible powered design before fresh confirmation. Existing protocol ticket status and historical evidence are unchanged.
